purpose: Qwen3.6 hybrid GDN recurrent-state depth failure isolation

state_trace_schema.accepted_source_physical: staging block containing accepted recurrent state
state_trace_schema.conv_destination_logical: working block selected for next convolution state read
state_trace_schema.copy_required: accepted count greater than one in spec-decode align mode
state_trace_schema.crossed_boundary: newly accepted tokens crossed an aligned block boundary
state_trace_schema.expected_copy_pairs: source/destination physical block pairs for SSM, conv, and boundary state
state_trace_schema.invariant_passed: next-step persistent state equals last accepted staging state
state_trace_schema.legacy_next_state_marker: state marker visible to unpatched next verification
state_trace_schema.legacy_window_logical: logical indices selected from scheduled seq_len
state_trace_schema.legacy_window_physical: physical state blocks selected for recurrent kernel
state_trace_schema.num_accepted_tokens: sampled tokens including bonus token, minimum one
state_trace_schema.num_draft_tokens: draft tokens supplied for this request row
state_trace_schema.num_scheduled_tokens: target tokens executed in this verification
state_trace_schema.offset_before: last committed token offset within aligned block
state_trace_schema.oracle_next_state_marker: state marker expected after explicit commit copy
state_trace_schema.ssm_destination_logical: logical block containing last newly committed token
state_trace_schema.ssm_destination_physical: persistent block read by next verification step
